note: Second preflight pass. The first pass tested only the OpenAI-compatible gateways. This pass tests the Claude Code subscription route, which is the only route that reaches Fable 5.1 at all.

gateway_reverification.note: A raw urllib probe of the same endpoints returns Cloudflare 403 'error code: 1010' and is not valid evidence. Only the harness adapter's client is used here.
gateway_reverification.conclusion: Unchanged from the first pass. No Fable 5.1 on either gateway under any of five spellings; the allowlist the 401 enumerates contains claude-fable-5 and no 5.1. claude-fable-5 itself is blocked by credit exhaustion.

probes.prompt: What is 17 * 23? Reply with just the number.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.note: harness auxiliary call, not part of the answer; removed by DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS=1

probes.probe: claude -p, same flags + DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS=1, one-character prompt
probes.finding: auxiliary haiku call eliminated. 261 input tokens for a 6-token system prompt plus a 1-token user turn establishes a fixed residual context of roughly 254 tokens that --system-prompt does not replace.

probes.probe: claude -p, same flags, verbatim-echo of all injected context
probes.system_prompt_actually_sent: You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.You are a helpful assistant.
probes.injected_into_first_user_turn: <system-reminder> block carrying: # userEmail (bperez@helmcode.com) and # currentDate 'Today's date is 2026-09-02.'
probes.finding: The frozen system prompt is prefixed by an unremovable Agent SDK preamble, and a system-reminder carrying the REAL date is injected into the user turn. monday-002 sets current_time 2026-09-14T09:07:00+02:00.

probes.probe: claude -p with CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1 (the --bare mode that would strip the injected context)
probes.finding: --bare / CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1 refuses OAuth by design and requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. That key is empty and spending Anthropic API credit is a hard project rule violation. So the injected context cannot be removed on any route that reaches the model.
